subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
10. 
Considering that this is the first year of audit and prior period auditor’s working papers 
are not available, along with change in accounting policy, what should the auditor 
primarily ensure? 
(a)  
Opening balances need not be verified 
(b)  
Only current year transactions should be verified 
(c)  
Obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence regarding opening balances and 
consistency of accounting policies 
(d)  
Rely completely on management representations
